The '''''Red Silk Chances''''' was a rather unclean [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that transported [[Shigar Konshi]] and [[Larin Moxla]] from [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] in [[3643 BBY]].
